title: the existence of batak toba women's land in patriarchal culture, indonesia
core_idea: Analyze how Batak Toba women maintain and manage inherited land within a patriarchal society, focusing on customary mechanisms (inheritance to daughters, transfers from husbands to wives, land-division techniques, and attestation by customary institutions such as dalihan na tolu) and the tension with state legal recognition.
tldr: Qualitative descriptive study investigating the roles of 180 Batak Toba women in sustaining and managing inherited land under patriarchal norms, examining customary 'safety valves' that support women's land claims and their interaction with state land registration.
